read_all: map -1 to each native wildcard API; raw messages omit Index
writes: single-index MODIFY, negative indexes remain negative and must not become wildcard writes
high_level_scope: absence of a dedicated helper is recorded separately; the two Go protocol controls retain arbitrary entity access
finsy_signed_extension_case: signed interfaces receive integers, not sign-extended byte arrays; ten representation-specific cases are not expressible through that input interface
validity: fixed typed numerical inputs, invalid widths, bounds, shape and indices; unsigned leading zero and signed sign extension are valid numerical representations
varbit: compare explicit dynamic bitwidth and numerical value; alternative byte-length policies are outside this corpus
scope_bmv2: wide EXACT and action values plus ordinary counter and meter indices; typed registers and controlled translation stay in the controlled service
bmv2_state: preload 0, 1 and maximum keys, use MODIFY, retain direct target snapshots before and after every case
analysis: bind input to actual Read or Write request, classify local rejection, target rejection, accepted request, empty read and high-level API error after an empty read; compare repeated classifications
exclusions: preflight and race records are not combined with the two formal runs; no unfavorable completed case is removed
